Population increased in Newham

The estimated population of Newham in 2024 was 374,523 usual residents, a rise of 1.7% since 2023.

This meant that Newham's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Newham increased by 6.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Newham was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Newham

The average (median) age fell to 31.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Newham has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Newham is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Newham's population of 374,523 usual residents was made up of:

  • 75,145 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.1%)
  • 271,170 people aged 16 to 64 years, (72.4%)
  • 28,208 people aged 65 years and over, (7.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Newham has a lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (7.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Newham, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Newham
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Newham, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 4,162 people (1.1%). In total, there were 5,520 births and 1,358 deaths in Newham.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 15,049 (-4.1%). There were 32,615 people entering the area and 47,664 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Newham's population of 17,224 (4.7%) as a result of 26,134 people entering the area and 8,910 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Newham was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Newham in mid-2023 is 368,194.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 6,075 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 433 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 5,642 people.
